{{Quote|One of the former technicians at the Stonewall Labs, Tanoa Vills, can make the sequencer for you. She's highly skilled and knows as much as anyone about the security measures built into the droids in the Labs.|Professor [[Zanier Hudmasse]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtTV" />}}
'''Tanoa Vills''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My my, Tanoa still does quite good work.|Professor Zanier Hudmasse, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtsBS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Recover the stolen Bio-Scanner|Naboo}}</ref>}}
Tanoa Vills was a technician of [[Stonewall Labs]] until the company was closed by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:GtTV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she met a spacer who was trying to acquire an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] droid module from Stonewall Labs. She agreed to build a [[sequencer]] that could be used in a Stonewall Labs [[security beacon]] for [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Zanier Hudmasse]]. She tasked the spacer with finding three components: an [[XJ5 circuit board]], some [[fractal transmitter]]s, and some [[octave regulator]]s. The spacer first acquired an XJ5 circuit board from [[Mummers|Mummer]] scientists in the [[Mummer Cave]]. The spacer found fractal transmitters in old data terminals in the Dee'ja Peak junkyard. The spacer finally got octave regulators from [[Skaak Tippers|Skaak Tipper]] machinists in the [[Skaak Tipper Cave]].<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Get the Parts for a Sequencer|Naboo}}</ref>

Tanoa Vills later asked the spacer to investigate a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that had just crashed in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]]. She needed the spacer to eliminate rabid [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatches]], including [[Grizzlefur]], that gathered at the crash site in order to salvage research equipment.<ref name="SWG:StEatCS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Salvage the Equipment at the Crashed Shuttle" on Naboo</ref> However, the [[Darkwalkers]] plundered the crash site before.<ref name="SWG:FowtDtfCS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Find out what the Darkwalkers took from the Crashed Shuttle" on Naboo</ref> Vills thus asked the spacer to raid the [[Darkwalker Cave (Dee'ja Peak)|Darkwalker Cave]] nearby to recover a stolen [[Bioscan/Legends|bio-scanner]]. When the spacer returned to her, Tanoa Vills gave the completed sequencer requested by Professor Hudmasse to the spacer.<ref name="SWG:RtsBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tanoa Vills appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GtTV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tanoa Vills was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
